name: foot
description: Boat-shaped foot with a rounded sole. Same part on the left and right leg. Connected to the servo above it by connecting rods.
mass_note: Solid PLA (100% infill), so an upper bound.

frame.z: up; z max (-3.25) = flat top face, z min (-22.5) = bottom of the rounded sole

rod_sockets.description: Square sockets in the top face, the same as the servo holder's. The prongs of the connecting rods from the servo above plug in here, one pair per side.

sole.description: Rounded underside that touches the ground. Narrows from 49.8 mm wide to about 15 mm at the very bottom.
